pictureoftheday-desc: Adds a rotating, locally scheduled picture-of-the-day component for Davispedia.
pictureoftheday-not-scheduled: No picture of the day has been scheduled.
pictureoftheday-invalid-file: The picture-of-the-day entry does not specify a valid file.
pictureoftheday-invalid-start-date: The picture-of-the-day queue start date “$1” is invalid. Use YYYY-MM-DD.
pictureoftheday-schedule-intro: Showing the next $1 days in $2 time. Edit this page to change the queue.
pictureoftheday-lookup-description: See which picture would appear on a date if the current queue and dated overrides do not change.
pictureoftheday-lookup-invalid-date: The date “$1” is invalid. Use YYYY-MM-DD.
pictureoftheday-lookup-assumption: This prediction uses the current queue and existing dated overrides. Future edits can change it.
